data.subject: Local Ledger for Stilwell Value
data.body:
Hi,

I’m Andrew, founder of Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only and never issuer-paid.

Your most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in SFBC, LSBK, and CPBI.

On September 23, 2026, CPBI disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing. (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1979332/000094337426000419/cpbi-20260922.htm)

Would you like the free weekly issue and a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
